intro: The Bauhaus collection was born out of a desire to break the monotony and bring a sense of play into everyday spaces. More than just cushions, they are vibrant statements designed to awaken any space with a burst of energy.

features.title: High-quality prints for lasting colour and vibrancy
features.text: A great print is only as good as how long it stays looking that way, which is why this cover is digitally printed using high-quality disperse inks. The result is excellent colour retention and colour fastness, helping prevent fading and keeping the Bauhaus design vibrant through everyday use.

features.title: Sturdy zipper closure for lasting durability
features.text: The small components of a cushion cover are often what determine how long it lasts, which is why the Bauhaus cover is finished with a high-quality zipper designed for smooth, repeated use. It opens and closes with ease, ensuring durability and extending the overall life of the product.

features.title: Shrink-resistant fabric for a fine, lasting finish
features.text: Fabric that holds its shape over time makes all the difference to how a cushion looks on the sofa or bed. The cotton slub material used in this cover is shrink-resistant, ensuring the cover keeps its fit and fine finish through everyday use and repeated washing.

care: Wash separately. Do not bleach, Iron at low temperature. Do not tumble dry, Do not dry clean.
name: Bauhaus Digital Print Cotton Slub Cushion Cover
